_comment: Accepted warnings of stylelint-config-obsidianmd on dist/<theme>/theme.css (research/14 §1.9). Errors are never listed: they are fixed. Each entry: rule, selector, property, theme ("*" or a theme), reason, refs; for declaration-no-important also `overrides` (the app.css rule being overridden). Every !important in the output must have an entry here (S4). An entry that no longer matches any warning fails S5 (stale entry).

warnings.overrides: app.css 1.14.4 L6579-6591: .is-translucent:not(.is-fullscreen) .mod-top .workspace-tab-header-container (and the other strip selectors) { background-color: transparent !important }
warnings.reason: While translucent, app.css forces the tab strips transparent with !important; Q-D1/Q-D22 need the note-list acrylic colour there. Specificity alone cannot beat an !important declaration.

warnings.overrides: app.css 1.14.4 L6579-6591: .is-translucent:not(.is-fullscreen) .workspace-ribbon.mod-primary { background-color: transparent !important }
warnings.reason: While translucent, app.css forces the ribbon transparent with !important; Q-D1/Q-D22 need the sidebar acrylic colour there.

warnings.overrides: app.css 1.14.4 L6579-6591: .is-translucent:not(.is-fullscreen) .workspace-sidedock-vault-profile { background-color: transparent !important }
warnings.reason: While translucent, app.css forces the vault profile at the bottom of the left dock transparent with !important; Q-D1/Q-D22 need the note-list acrylic colour there, as on the dock above it. Found in the step-4 native captures.

warnings.overrides: app.css 1.14.4 L6579-6591: .is-translucent:not(.is-fullscreen) .workspace-ribbon.mod-primary:before { background-color: transparent !important }
warnings.reason: While translucent, app.css forces the corner above the ribbon (under the macOS window buttons) transparent with !important; opaque it shows --titlebar-background (note list), so the note-list acrylic colour keeps it continuous with the tab strip. Missed in step 4, found in a native capture of the top-left corner.

The lint's browser data reports text-decoration as only partially supported by Chrome. The declaration reproduces Inkdrop's .md-inline-mark 3 px underline (syntax.css:723-726); the runtime checks measure it in Obsidian on Electron 39.5.1 and 43.7.7 (research/14 §6.11).

The lint's browser data reports text-decoration as only partially supported by Chrome. The declaration reproduces Inkdrop's .md-inline-mark text-decoration-skip-ink: none (syntax.css:727); the runtime checks measure it in Obsidian on Electron 39.5.1 and 43.7.7 (research/14 §6.11).

The lint's browser data reports text-decoration as only partially supported by Chrome. The declaration reproduces Inkdrop's .mde-preview mark 3 px underline (markdown.css:194-197); the runtime checks measure it in Obsidian on Electron 39.5.1 and 43.7.7 (research/14 §6.11).

The lint's browser data reports text-decoration as only partially supported by Chrome. The declaration reproduces Inkdrop's .task-list-item.checked strike-through colour (markdown.css:954); the runtime checks measure it in Obsidian on Electron 39.5.1 and 43.7.7 (research/14 §6.11).

The lint's browser data reports text-decoration as only partially supported by Chrome. The declaration reproduces Inkdrop's .md-task-done-text line-through (syntax.css:734) in Source mode; the runtime checks measure it in Obsidian on Electron 39.5.1 and 43.7.7 (research/14 §6.13).

warnings.overrides: Mermaid 11.13.0's own <style> inside each diagram SVG, scoped by the diagram's random id (e.g. #m8f3c1f55b7b95b07 .node rect { fill; stroke }, #m… { fill }), specificity 1-0-0 and up
warnings.reason: Q-D12 needs Inkdrop's --mermaid-* colours on Flowchart / Sequence elements; Mermaid's id-scoped rules beat any id-less selector, so only !important applies them (measured: the same rule without !important leaves Mermaid's colour). A user's style / classDef stays, as Mermaid emits it with !important inline or id-scoped.
